card.name: Punctuation after age-group dose headings
card.fires_on: Punctuation (colon, comma, semicolon) right after an age-group phrase such as "Adults & children above 12 years of age", just before the instruction begins. Also seen after a short intro clause before a new clause.

modes.label: Colon after age group
modes.description: A colon or comma closes an age-group phrase in a directions line, right before the dose instruction.
modes.example: Shake 10 times before use. Adults & children above 12 years of age<<:>> spray 3 - 4 times under

modes.label: Other clause breaks
modes.description: Punctuation or a verb after a short subject phrase in general web text, before the next clause.
modes.example: High school coaches<<;>> also for college undergraduates pursuing professions as

card.plain: It fires at the point just after "adults and children over 12 years" where the dose instructions start.
